web.description: Location. Midsummer Prog Festival will be held at the stunning Richie Backfireplein at the Muziekgieterij Courtyard in Maastricht, Netherlands!
web.markdown:
![Image](https://midsummerprog.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/MSP-Logo-2026.png)

# AN INTIMATE & EPIC FESTIVAL EXPERIENCE LIKE NO OTHER

[2026 Tickets](https://muziekgieterij.stager.co/shop/midsummerprog) [Learn More](https://midsummerprog.com/#lineup)

# Richie Backfireplein

# Muziekgieterij Courtyard Maastricht, Netherlands

# 2026 Line-up

# Saturday 20th June 2026

# Geoff Tate

Operation Mindcrime

# Einar Solberg

# Quidam

# Blowbeat

# Ok Goodnight

# Benthos

# Sunday 21st June 2026

# Tesseract

# Amarok

# Cyan

# Overhead, The Albatross

# Ursa

# Location

Midsummer Prog Festival will be held at the stunning Richie Backfireplein at the Muziekgieterij Courtyard in Maastricht, Netherlands! Nestled in this vibrant city—where cobblestone streets wind past historic architecture and the Maas River reflects a timeless charm—the courtyard’s intimate, open-air setting, framed by Maastricht’s enchanting beauty, will bring those familiar festival vibes—lush acoustics, starlit skies, and a warm, communal energy—ensuring another unforgettable celebration of progressive music!

[![Image](https://midsummerprog.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/midsummer-logo-white.png)](https://midsummerprog.com/)
